text:
dara: FYI Argus Pharma flagged excessive standby billing on invoice INV-2026-0789 after we had a regional failover yesterday. they say standby GPUs billed for an extra 4 hours across 3 nodes. can finance approve a one-time adjustment?

kevin: need reconciled usage + proposed credit amount. do we have any SLA or contract language around failover/standby?

dara: attached reconciliation in the ticket. short summary: committed baseline covered 500 GPU-hours, billed 512 GPU-hours for baseline + standby; extra standby billed = 64 GPU-hours (3 nodes * ~4h * 5.333 GPU-equivalent), customer asking for $8,200.

meenal: ops looked into it — autoscaler label mismatch prevented graceful drain during the failover window. incident INC-2026-1199. logs show nodes stayed in Ready for several minutes then refused terminate. snippet: ```
2026-03-02T14:05:12Z autoscaler: mark-evict node-rtx-11 labels=region:eu-west
2026-03-02T14:06:01Z autoscaler: drain-request node-rtx-11
2026-03-02T14:10:34Z kubelet: PodTerminated timeout on node-rtx-11
2026-03-02T18:12:43Z autoscaler: terminate-succeeded node-rtx-11
```

jade: from sales: customer is on an annual enterprise commit E-ARGUS-2025. they want the full credit as a goodwill gesture. i'm cautious about precedent; prefer excusing only incremental standby overages.

kevin: agree with sales direction — finance will approve excess-only credit. what's the GL code?

dara: accounting says GL 6405-CUST-CREDIT. need memo referencing INV-2026-0789 and INC-2026-1199, posting period Mar 2026. also confirm whether to treat as contra-revenue.

meenal: ops confirms root cause on our side (label handling bug). fix deployed in the hotpath same day.

kevin: +1 from finance lead (kevin). approving one-time excess credit up to $8,200 to settle. document as contra-revenue per policy, but confirm with accounting.

dara: accounting: please route to 6405-CUST-CREDIT and post in Mar close. I'll create the memo and tag approvers for initials.

billing-bot: action queued: create credit memo -8200 USD for INV-2026-0789, tags: credit:argus-standby-exception, memo:INC-2026-1199. Will post in nightly batch.

jade: customer notified and accepts excess-only credit and a note in renewal that this was an operational exception.

billing-bot: invoice INV-2026-0789 updated: credit posted (-8200 USD). audit id: AUD-2026-7810.

kevin: decision logged here: one-off excess standby credit approved ($8,200), contra-rev, memo filed. closing thread.

dara: thanks everyone. memo attached to ticket.
